note: Module roles named by scripts/architecture/rules.mjs. Every include/exclude pattern must match an existing file, so moving or renaming a listed module fails `pnpm check:architecture` until this map is updated in the same change. `anticipate` patterns guard files that do not exist yet and are exempt from that check. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

biome.pale.sources.purpose: Pale-owned gameplay modules that must not reach Verdant implementation, directly or transitively.

biome.verdant.sources.purpose: Verdant-owned gameplay modules that must not reach Pale implementation, directly or transitively.

biome.pale.implementation.purpose: Every module that implements Pale-specific behaviour (gameplay, app wiring); forbidden targets for Verdant and neutral code.

biome.verdant.implementation.purpose: Every module that implements Verdant-specific behaviour (gameplay, presentation, app wiring, TearBench forge); forbidden targets for Pale and neutral code.

environment.neutral-foundation.purpose: The biome-neutral environment runtime, state, contracts, ports, events and codecs; may not import any biome implementation.

environment.neutral-schema.purpose: Neutral environment, codec and telemetry schema modules that must not contain biome-owned vocabulary.

gameplay.portable-core.purpose: The C27A portable simulation composition: outward app/device adapters are supplied through ports.

gameplay.world-bootstrap.purpose: The generic world bootstrap, which receives base configuration from its caller.

tearbench.detached-world.purpose: Detached TearBench world hydration and runtime, portable outside the browser app.

tearbench.production-headless-entry.purpose: The production headless environment entry, run outside any browser.

tearbench.portable-live-runtime.purpose: Portable live TearBench environment and action routing.

tearbench.browser-adapters.purpose: Browser-facing TearBench adapters and developer UI.

tearbench.portable-barrel.purpose: The portable TearBench barrel consumed by headless and test code.

tearbench.developer-surfaces.purpose: Browser/developer UI and test-support modules that the portable barrel must not expose.

tearbench.ghost-inspector-adapter.purpose: The browser adapter that owns the Ghost V3 test inspection global.

replay.ghost2-compat.purpose: The Ghost 2 compatibility adapter, which portable research code must not depend on.

replay.ghost2-compat-family.purpose: The Ghost 2 compatibility adapter and its validation module, which portable and browser TearBench code and the portable gameplay core must not reach.

replay.ghost-recorder-session-owners.purpose: The Ghost V3 recorder and its typed live recording-session owner.

remote.adapters.purpose: Remote-service adapters; none exist yet, so game-reference purity guards their future paths.

config.game-config.purpose: The broad gameplay configuration module and its process-level singletons.

presentation.cosmetic-random.purpose: The cosmetic entropy source, created by composition and passed to renderers.

audio.context-handoff.purpose: The browser audio-context handoff constructed per composition.

audio.context-handoff-consumers.purpose: The only modules that may import the handoff: the composition root and the first-gesture audio facade.

gameplay.world-runtime-types.purpose: Concrete live world state types that portable TearBench code must not consume.

app.live-runtime-root.purpose: The live runtime wiring root (startLiveGame); it composes typed owners and must not own world, interface or session state itself.

app.navigator-owners.purpose: App modules that may touch the browser navigator directly; everything else in src/app receives it through the composition port.

app.document-owners.purpose: App modules that may touch the browser document directly; everything else in src/app receives it through the composition port.

app.window-owners.purpose: App modules that may touch the browser window directly; everything else in src/app receives it through the composition port.

app.music-direction-owner.purpose: The world composition, the only constructor of the music director.

app.world-construction-owners.purpose: The production-world roots (the live root and the detached TearBench replay world, which share the one world constructor) and the session/composition modules they construct.

progress.direct-profile-writers.purpose: Modules that still write PROFILE directly instead of through a composition-owned persistence adapter. Ratchet target: empty (plan step 12).

release.developer-only.purpose: Developer and test code that no release build may contain: the scripted test player, the playtest tool, TearBench's browser and test-support modules and the debug harness. Other code may load it only through a dynamic import guarded by a build constant, and a release build fails when one of these modules contributes code to a bundle (scripts/release-developer-code.mjs).

release.mobile-only.purpose: Phone and tablet code that a production build leaves out while mobile is paused (owner, 2026-11-19; plans/MOBILE_LATER.md): the touch input layer and its control layout, the drawn touch controls and their coaching, the rotate gate and the phone profile layout. Other code reaches it only behind __TEAR_MOBILE__, and a build of a target whose mobile is false in config/build-targets.json fails when one of these modules contributes code to a bundle (scripts/release-developer-code.mjs).

release.mobile-guarded-importers.purpose: Shared modules that value-import mobile-only code and reach it only behind __TEAR_MOBILE__, so a production build shakes it out. A new importer goes through one of these.

release.build-guarded-importers.purpose: Release modules that still import developer-only code with a static import and rely on a build constant and tree-shaking to drop it. Ratchet target: empty.

size.authored-data-exceptions.purpose: Authored data tables exempt from the 700-line (line-equivalent) module limit.
